scientific_integrity: Exact all-alphabet proof uses labeled Euler tours, contraction, directed matrix-tree cofactors and an explicit de Bruijn Markov-chain group inverse. Exhaustive binary enumeration and independent small-alphabet cofactor calculations are verification, not substitutes for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Uniform probability on labeled cyclic order-four de Bruijn words only. Counts length-five ordinary reversal palindromes, not arbitrary lengths or reverse-complement factors. Does not give variance or full distribution; literature priority remains subject to inaccessible conference chapters and unindexed sources.
title: Exact five-letter palindrome probabilities in order-four de Bruijn cycles
